description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LoginLogServiceTest' for testing the 'LoginLogService' component within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It includes setup and multiple test methods to validate login log creation, interaction with the DAO layer, and login operations such as standard and OIDC logins.

classes.name: LoginLogServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LoginLogService component, including tests for log retrieval, login logging, and OIDC login logging functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new LoginService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetLoginLogDao
methods.description: Verifies that the LoginService correctly provides a LoginLogDao instance.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Tests the process of saving a login log entry, including user retrieval, session interaction, and timestamp validation.

methods.name: testAddOIDCLogin
methods.description: Validates adding a login log for an OpenID Connect login, checking user attributes and login time.
